amazon_c0.title: Product Information and Customer Engagement
amazon_c0.summary: These APIs allow users to search for products, retrieve detailed product information, and manage customer-generated content like reviews and questions. They also facilitate tracking and displaying user-specific product interactions such as browsing history and purchase records.

amazon_c1.title: Amazon Customer Account and Transaction Management
amazon_c1.summary: This API community enables users to manage their Amazon account details, including personal information and payment methods, as well as handle orders, returns, and Prime subscriptions.

amazon_c2.title: User Account Data and Item Removal
amazon_c2.summary: These APIs provide functionality for users to remove or delete personal data, account information, and various items associated with their Amazon account, including browsing history, cart contents, and product interactions.

amazon_c3.title: User Account and Profile Management
amazon_c3.summary: These APIs enable users to create, verify, and secure their accounts. They also provide functionalities for managing personal information, addresses, and payment methods.

amazon_c4.title: Shopping Cart and Wish List Management
amazon_c4.summary: This capability enables comprehensive management of items within a user's shopping cart and wish list, supporting additions, quantity updates, and transfers.

file_system_c0.title: File and Directory System Management
file_system_c0.summary: This set of APIs allows for comprehensive management of files and directories, including creation, deletion, copying, moving, compression, decompression, and content updates.

file_system_c1.title: User Account and Profile Management
file_system_c1.summary: This set of APIs allows users to create, verify, update, and delete their accounts. It also provides functionalities for password management and retrieving account or profile details.

file_system_c2.title: File System Content and Structure Management
file_system_c2.summary: These APIs allow for the management of file system content and structure, including checking existence, creating directories, and retrieving information about files and directories.

gmail_c0.title: Email Thread and Account State Management
gmail_c0.summary: These APIs provide comprehensive control over email thread states, including marking, archiving, and snoozing, alongside managing user account status and deletion.

gmail_c1.title: Manage and View Email Threads
gmail_c1.summary: This capability enables comprehensive management and interaction with email threads, including forwarding, labeling, replying, and viewing threads across different categories.

gmail_c2.title: Gmail Account and Email Management
gmail_c2.summary: This community provides capabilities for managing user accounts, including creation, profile updates, and password resets. It also supports sending, viewing, and searching for emails.

gmail_c3.title: Gmail Email Draft Management
gmail_c3.summary: This capability enables comprehensive management of email drafts, including creation, retrieval, modification, and sending. It also supports attachment handling for drafts.

phone_c0.title: User Account and Content Management
phone_c0.summary: This capability enables comprehensive management of user accounts, including creation, authentication, and deletion. It also provides functionalities for removing associated user content like contacts and messages.

phone_c1.title: Text and Voice Message Management
phone_c1.summary: These APIs provide comprehensive functionality for managing text and voice messages. They allow for searching, sending, and displaying details of both types of messages.

phone_c2.title: Personal Information and Contact Management
phone_c2.summary: Enables comprehensive management of user account profiles and contact book entries, including creation, retrieval, and modification.

phone_c3.title: Time and Alarm Management
phone_c3.summary: Provides capabilities for managing alarms, including creation, deletion, viewing, and updating. It also allows for retrieving current date and time information.

simple_note_c0.title: User Account Management and Security
simple_note_c0.summary: These APIs provide comprehensive functionalities for managing user accounts, including creation, authentication, profile updates, and deletion. They also support account security features such as password resets and verification processes.

simple_note_c1.title: User Note Management and Content Operations
simple_note_c1.summary: This capability enables the full lifecycle management of user notes, including creation, content modification, searching, and deletion.

splitwise_c0.title: Expense and Payment Comment and Transaction Management
splitwise_c0.summary: This API community facilitates the full lifecycle management of comments on expenses and payments. It also allows for viewing and updating the underlying expense and payment transactions.

splitwise_c1.title: Splitwise Group and Membership Management
splitwise_c1.summary: These APIs provide comprehensive capabilities for managing groups, including creation, modification, deletion, and membership control. Users can interact with group invitations, members, and group details.

splitwise_c2.title: Expense and Payment Record Management
splitwise_c2.summary: These APIs enable the creation, modification, and deletion of expense and payment records. They also support attaching, downloading, and deleting associated receipt files.

splitwise_c3.title: Managing Shared Expenses and Balances
splitwise_c3.summary: This capability enables tracking, viewing, and managing shared expenses, payments, and balances with individuals and within groups. It provides functionalities to record financial transactions and retrieve detailed balance information.

splitwise_c4.title: User Account and Profile Management
splitwise_c4.summary: These APIs enable the creation, verification, and management of user accounts and profiles. They support operations such as signing up, resetting passwords, verifying accounts, and updating personal details.

splitwise_c5.title: User Notification Management and Retrieval
splitwise_c5.summary: Provides comprehensive functionality for users to manage their notifications, including viewing, deleting, and updating their read status.

spotify_c0.title: Spotify Content and User Data Access
spotify_c0.summary: These APIs enable searching for and retrieving details about music content such as albums, songs, and playlists. They also provide access to a user's personal music library, liked items, and recommendations.

spotify_c1.title: User Account and Subscription Management
spotify_c1.summary: This capability enables comprehensive management of user accounts, including profile details, security, payment methods, and premium subscriptions.

spotify_c2.title: Music Playback and Queue Management
spotify_c2.summary: These APIs enable comprehensive control over music playback, including playing, pausing, and seeking songs. They also provide full management capabilities for the song queue, such as adding, removing, and reordering tracks.

spotify_c3.title: Spotify Content Review and Rating Management
spotify_c3.summary: These APIs facilitate the complete lifecycle management of user reviews and ratings for Spotify content such as albums, playlists, and songs. Users can create, view, update, and delete their feedback on various media.

spotify_c4.title: User Music Library Management
spotify_c4.summary: This capability allows users to manage their personal music collections by adding, liking, or unliking albums, songs, and playlists.

spotify_c5.title: Spotify Content Library Management
spotify_c5.summary: These APIs enable comprehensive management of a user's Spotify content, including creating, updating, and deleting playlists, and managing songs and albums in their library.

spotify_c6.title: Artist Information and Following Management
spotify_c6.summary: This capability enables searching for artists, retrieving their details, and managing a user's artist following status on Spotify.

todoist_c0.title: Todoist Project and Task Management
todoist_c0.summary: These APIs provide comprehensive capabilities for creating, viewing, and organizing projects, tasks, sub-tasks, and sections within Todoist. They also support project collaboration through invitations and label management.

todoist_c1.title: Todoist Item Deletion and Removal
todoist_c1.summary: This capability enables the deletion of various Todoist entities like tasks, projects, and accounts, and the removal of assignments, labels, or collaborators.

todoist_c2.title: Todoist User Account and Profile Management
todoist_c2.summary: This capability enables the creation, verification, and management of user accounts and profiles, including password resets and updating personal details.

todoist_c3.title: Manage Todoist Labels, Projects, and Tasks
todoist_c3.summary: This capability enables the creation, retrieval, and modification of labels, projects, sections, and tasks within the Todoist application.

todoist_c4.title: Task Comment and Attachment Management
todoist_c4.summary: This set of APIs enables full lifecycle management of comments on tasks, including creation, retrieval, updates, and deletion. It also provides capabilities for handling attachments associated with these task comments, such as uploading, downloading, and deleting.

todoist_c5.title: Managing Todoist User Notifications
todoist_c5.summary: Provides functionalities to list, count, delete, and mark Todoist notifications as read or unread.

venmo_c0.title: Venmo Financial Activity and Record Access
venmo_c0.summary: This capability enables users to view and manage their financial transactions, payment methods, and related records within Venmo. It includes accessing transaction history, payment card details, payment requests, and downloading receipts.

venmo_c1.title: Venmo Payment and Funding Management
venmo_c1.summary: These APIs facilitate the management of payment methods, execution of financial transactions, and processing of payment requests within the Venmo platform.

venmo_c2.title: Transaction Comment and Engagement Management
venmo_c2.summary: This capability allows for the creation, retrieval, update, and deletion of transaction comments, and enables social engagement through liking and unliking transactions and their comments.

venmo_c3.title: Venmo User Account Management
venmo_c3.summary: This capability enables users to create, manage, secure, and delete their Venmo accounts. It covers operations such as signup, password reset, account verification, and profile updates.

venmo_c4.title: User Notification Management
venmo_c4.summary: These APIs enable users to retrieve, count, delete, and update the read status of their notifications. They provide comprehensive control over a user's notification inbox.

venmo_c5.title: User and Friend Information Management
venmo_c5.summary: These APIs provide capabilities to manage user accounts and friend relationships, including searching for users, adding/removing friends, and viewing profile or account details.
